Make heat map from MW-score txt file
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(pheatmap)

# Read tab-delimited file 
mw_score <- read.delim("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/65phylum/MW-score_result.txt",
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

# Extract numeric phylum contribution data
phylum_matrix <- as.matrix(mw_score[, -(1:2)])  # drop Function + MW-score columns
rownames(phylum_matrix) <- mw_score$Function

# ht2 matrix with MW-score column
ht2_matrix <- data.frame(
  Function = mw_score$Function,
  MW_score = as.numeric(mw_score$`MW-score for each function`),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Color functions
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
  c(
    "#F7FBFF",
    "#A6CEE3",
    "#5A9CCB",
    "#2F6FAE",
    "#123F73"
  )
)
mw_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(
    min(ht2_matrix$MW_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(ht2_matrix$MW_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  c(
    "#F7FBFF",
    "#123F73"
  )
)

# ---- Function column as its own heatmap (ht3) ----
ht3 <- Heatmap(
  matrix(1, nrow = nrow(ht2_matrix), ncol = 1), # placeholder numeric
  name = "Function",
  col = "white",
  width = unit(90, "mm"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    grid.text(ht2_matrix$Function[i], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
  }
)

# ---- MW-score column heatmap (ht2) ----
ht2 <- Heatmap(
  matrix(ht2_matrix$MW_score, ncol = 1),
  name = "MW-score",
  col = mw_col_fun,
  width = unit(10, "mm"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", ht2_matrix$MW_score[i]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))
  }
)

# ---- Main phylum heatmap ----
ht <- Heatmap(
  phylum_matrix,
  name = "Contribution %",
  col = col_fun,
  width = unit(30, "mm"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", phylum_matrix[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))
  }
)

# ---- Draw everything side by side ----
draw(ht3 + ht2 + ht)

svg(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/mw_score/phyla_mw_score.svg",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

draw(ht3 + ht2 + ht)

dev.off()




```
